blind_spots.blind_to: add_api_route paths built by string concatenation (e.g. '/ai-employee/work-inbox/' + path); only literal arg0 paths are recovered
transitions synthesized at runtime — lifecycle._build_edges universal edges, employee_work_inbox set-unions and dict-comprehension splats; only enum members are recovered
event_type values built from f-strings / variables rather than string literals
keys read via indirection or a settings object rather than a direct os.environ/os.getenv literal
the product package finalis/ exposes no argparse CLI; only governance tooling under tools/ does (out of product scope)
routes are read only from finalis/portal/app.py and finalis/portal/ui.py; a route defined in any other module would not be seen (file-scoped detector)
migrations are read only from finalis/portal/db.py, and a migration whose version is a non-literal is skipped (its DDL is recorded as NON_LITERAL_SQL rather than dropped)
run-ledger events are read only from the EVENT_SCHEMA dict in finalis/ai_employee/run_ledger.py (file-scoped)
